selections.title: DHCP server - Command line test: ARP Probe
selections.justification: Test for Ping/ARP Probe commands | step1: •probe enable •no probe enable •probe type {ping|arp} •no probe type •probe packets <0-10> •no probe packets •probe time => Test for commands accepted Test for illegal values/arguments refused Test

selections.title: (27) IPv4_DHCPServer - DHCP ARP Probe
selections.justification:
Test for enable and disable probing in DHCP Server Use this command to enable/disable lease probing for a DHCP pool.
probe enable (enabled by default)
no probe enable
To enable probing for pool P2, use the commands:
awplus# configure terminal
awplus(config)# ip dhcp pool P2
awplus(config-if)# probe enable
To disable probing for pool P2, use the commands:
awplus# configure terminal
awplus(config)# ip dhcp pool P2
awplus(dhcp-config)# no probe enable

selections.justification: ATMF Minor Clients  License - Autorecovery blocked when no license

selections.title:
The "dhcp" directory is not created in NVS though enabling DHCP server.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the DHCP directory is recreated in NVS when needed. The test confirms the DHCP directory exists, deletes it from the underlying shell, reboots the device, and confirms the directory is automatically recreated.
selections.justification: Relevant based on keyword overlap with case title and selections

selections.title:
Web auth supplicant in the guest vlan can communicate to other vlan interface on x900

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a web-auth supplicant in the guest VLAN cannot reach other VLAN interfaces. The test confirms baseline connectivity before auth-web is enabled, configures web authentication with guest VLANs on ports, and confirms guest-VLAN ARP and inter-VLAN reachability behave as expected so a guest cannot communicate with other VLAN interfaces.
selections.justification: Relevant based on keyword overlap with case title and selections

selections.title:
Radius : error message when importing users to Local Radius Server

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that users can be imported into the local RADIUS server without error messages. The test exports the local RADIUS user database to a CSV file, replaces the database from the file, deletes the users, then re-imports them from the CSV and confirms both users are present afterwards.
selections.justification: Relevant based on keyword overlap with case title and selections

step4.objective:
• The port with no pluggable defaults to automatic MDI/MDIX polarity handling.
  • Inserting a supported pluggable resolves polarity and establishes link.
  • A port configured for Auto speed and duplex establishes a link with a compliant partner.
  • The port accurately reports Auto mode together with the negotiated speed and duplex values.
